Gotta Be Garage

About Gotta Be Garage

Introducing Gotta Be Garage — a high-octane 6-piece UK Garage live show that reignites everything we love about the scene and delivers it straight to your dancefloor. Built for big singalongs, basslines, and hands-in-the-air moments, this band blends the best of UK Garage , R&amp;B , Pop , and Soul to keep every guest hooked from the first drop to the final rewind. Fronted by two powerhouse female lead vocalists — Kimi and Melinda — plus Rya on MC/Rap , Gotta Be Garage brings the perfect mix of live musicianship and club energy. Expect iconic throwbacks and modern floor-fillers inspired by the likes of Sweet Female Attitude , So Solid Crew , and Craig David — with the option to thread Garage throughout the night or save it for a final-set “Garage get-down” that finishes your party on a ridiculous high. Kimi is a seasoned performer with major stage credentials, including West End productions and high-profile TV appearances — bringing confidence, charisma, and serious vocal firepower. Melinda , a California-born singer-songwriter and award-winner, has surpassed one million Spotify streams , earned major competition accolades, and toured internationally — delivering soul, edge, and star quality in every performance. And with Rya leading the crowd as your MC , you get that essential Garage flavour: hype, flow, and feel-good interaction that turns guests into a proper party. With an extensive repertoire and a flexible, client-first approach, Gotta Be Garage welcomes your setlist picks, can learn a special request (perfect for a first dance ), and provides DJ-style playlists , optional band-member DJing , and a full PA &amp; lighting setup — so you can tick entertainment off your list in one swoop.
